informational_observations.summary: Cycle 2 expanded scope mid-cycle. The cycle-2 dispatch brief (per reconciliation-log-cycle2.md) targeted only the 11 stage-number violations from I-CA-004. However, during the pre-round-3 sanity sweep, 4 stale `plan-v1.md` body references were discovered in acceptance-tests-v1.1.0.md and phase-validators-v1.1.0.md (derivative defects from the supersession of plan-v1.md → plan-v1.2.0.md). Rather than triggering an additional reconciliation cycle, these were fixed in-place under the still-draft v1.1.0 supersessions, with the expanded scope documented in each artifact's Update History entry. This is a procedural deviation from the strict 'audit-finds-then-reconciliation-fixes' discipline; the rationale was that the stale references were derivative consequences of cycle-2's own supersession work (not independent defects).
informational_observations.non_action: Acceptable as authored. Cycle-2 scope expansion is documented; provenance trail is complete; round-3 audit verified clean.
